title: AquaTerra in May 2025: {count} drives, mostly for children
description: AquaTerra's May 2025: {count} drives, most of them children's workshops at Pather Sathi, plus a clothes collection, a sharbat distribution and a dog feeding drive.
lede: In May 2025 AquaTerra ran {count} drives with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. Most were workshops for children, many of them at Pather Sathi, and the rest were a clothes and notebooks collection, a sharbat distribution for the summer heat and a feeding drive for stray dogs.

sections.heading: a month of children's workshops
body: Most of the {count} drives in May 2025 were workshops for children, and five of them ran at Pather Sathi between 17 and 31 May. Smiles in Sync and Warm Hours were fun workshops for the whole group, Curtain Call was a theatre session where the children acted and laughed, and Poetry Play explored rhythm and self-expression in verse.

Word Weavers at AIM Foundation worked on imagination through stories and narration. Groove Time at Tetultala Ashram put dance on the list, and Speech Ready at Ek Tara introduced children to the art of talking in front of an audience. Each one was a single session run by a small team, so a new member could join one without a long commitment.

sections.heading: clothes, sharbat and a dog feeding drive
body: The Wear & Write collection at Salarpuria Pearl in Gopalpur, on 12 May, was the month's clothes and notebooks campaign. The write-up for that drive says 6 kgs collected, and it had the largest team of the month.

Sharbat Seva on 3 May at Teghoria was a distribution drive where cooling sharbat was served to beat the summer heat with kindness. The write-up says 20L of Rooh Afza was distributed. Tails and Treats 35.0 on 10 May was the month's feeding drive, listed under Kolkata, and its write-up says 40 dogs fed. The students cuddled and fed the dogs, which is what the [Tails and Treats](/impact/tails-and-treats) series is about.

sections.heading: where the month went
body: Across May 2025 we worked in {placesCount} places, and most drives ran at {topPlace}. Other stops included AIM Foundation, Ek Tara, Tetultala Ashram and Teghoria, with the clothes collection at Salarpuria Pearl in Gopalpur. These are places we keep going back to, so a new member gets to know a few spaces well rather than arriving somewhere new every week.
If you want to see what happens before and after a session, [how a drive works](/impact/how-a-drive-works) walks through it step by step.

sections.heading: how to join in
body: You join AquaTerra with a Google sign-in, and a member of the team approves your account. AquaTerra is for students aged 14 to 19, and the workshops are planned and run by students. The [projects page](/projects) lists the drives we have written up, so you can see the kind of work before you join.

learnings: A month of workshops is a steady way in: the same places come back, so you meet the same children and the same team more than once.
Pather Sathi carried May, so a member who joins in a month like this is likely to end up there.
A mixed month works well. A clothes collection, a sharbat distribution and a feeding drive sat alongside the children's sessions without crowding them out.
Short themed sessions, such as a poetry workshop or a theatre session, are easy to repeat and easy to explain to a friend.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do in May 2025?
faqs.a: In May 2025 AquaTerra ran {count} drives with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. Most were workshops for children, many at Pather Sathi, and the month also included a clothes and notebooks collection, a sharbat distribution and a stray dog feeding drive.

faqs.q: Where did AquaTerra hold its drives in May 2025?
faqs.a: Most May 2025 drives ran at {topPlace}, with others at AIM Foundation, Ek Tara, Tetultala Ashram, Teghoria and Salarpuria Pearl in Gopalpur. In total the month covered {placesCount} places, and the feeding drive is listed under Kolkata.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra feed dogs in May 2025?
faqs.a: Yes. Tails and Treats 35.0 fed dogs on 10 May 2025 in Kolkata, and its write-up says 40 dogs fed. The students who ran it cuddled and fed the dogs as well as feeding them.

faqs.q: How can a 16-year-old join an AquaTerra children's workshop?
faqs.a: Sign in with Google, and a member of the team approves your account. AquaTerra is for students aged 14 to 19, and the children's workshops are planned and run by students, so you would work on the session with a team.
